issues.competing_evidence: Anzolin+08 RV solution 4.402±0.014 h lists 4.029±0.014 and 4.846±0.014 h aliases and does not confirm Gänsicke+05 160.21±0.12 min. Bruch+24 TESS prose gives 0.20193(7) d but Table 3 gives 0.20191(2) d (Class C); Dağ+26 interprets ≈4.85 h as orbital from same archival TESS data.
issues.why_it_matters: Period choice affects geometry, donor prediction, spin/orbit ratio and population comparison; agreement is alias consistency, not independent TESS observations.
issues.needed_action: Keep all values. Provisional catalog scalar uses Table 3. Obtain new phase-resolved spectroscopy/independent orbital timing and resolve prose/table difference before treating period as definitive.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+17 print: X 147±23 μJy at 8.7 GHz LCP-only Mar 9; C 121±20 μJy at 5.4 GHz RCP-only Mar 10. VizieR table34: X 45 μJy/−87%, C 108 μJy/+57%, no errors. Barrett+20: C Stokes I 43±9, RR 80±12, LL 0±11, CP +100±20%; X I 23±9, RR 0±15, LL 53±15, CP −100±40%; exact dates/ObsIDs not printed.
issues.why_it_matters: Flux and Stokes conventions materially affect radio-emission comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Retain products separately. Obtain calibrated measurement sets/reduction logs or independent VLA re-reduction to map channel-only, electronic-table and Stokes products before selecting a Stokes-I value.

issues.parameter: X-ray model / WD mass / Lacc / Mdot
issues.competing_evidence: Anzolin+08 Table 4 contains alternative Models A–C. Sect.4.2 gives BB bolometric flux 2.6–5.6e−12, Lacc>1.1e33 d800² and Mdot~1e16 d800²; later it gives BB flux 2.9e−13, Lacc>1.3e32 d500², Mdot>0.8–1e15 d500², and WD mass 0.61–0.76 Msun, while another passage gives ≥0.52 Msun at kTmax≥24 keV. Rendered pp.10–11 confirm mismatch.
issues.why_it_matters: The discrepancy changes inferred accretion power/rate and WD mass in cross-system comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Check for erratum/author clarification and reconcile component decomposition, model and state. Ledger preserves all claims; no single secure Lacc, Mdot or WD mass adopted.

issues.competing_evidence: Gänsicke+05 optical spin 1520.510±0.066 s; Anzolin+08 X-ray spin 1528±6 s; Bruch+25 TESS LC1/2/3/5 cluster near 1520.37–.39 s, LC4=1520.494±.014 s flagged outlier. Bruch+25 finds later values consistent with Petrik+15 and questions Andronov+11 spin-up; Petrik+15 currently available only through Mukai secondary page.
issues.why_it_matters: A claimed torque/Pdot may depend on cycle counts, timing method or a discrepant datum.
issues.needed_action: Obtain Petrik+15 and Andronov+11 originals and fit one documented timing solution; no Pdot adopted meanwhile.

issues.competing_evidence: Anzolin+08 predicts M3±1 from old 4.4 h period and assumes donor supplies all K-band flux; Gänsicke+05 detects no late donor features. Provisional TESS period is about 4.846 h. No donor spectrum/dynamical mass in checked papers.
issues.why_it_matters: Period-based model value could be mistaken for measured donor type, mass or temperature.
issues.needed_action: Retain M3±1 as legacy prediction only. If comparison requires donor properties, compute sequence estimates under both period choices and clearly label them; measured subtype needs spectral/IR decomposition.

issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 Table 2 gives 3210±365 G assuming donor-coronal fundamental ECM (ν≈2.8B MHz); location is not uniquely resolved and this is not WD surface B. Table 2 radio luminosity is 5277×10^21 erg/s with 256 MHz footnote, while the printed convention/formula appears not to include standard 4π.
issues.why_it_matters: Confusing radio-region B with WD field or per-steradian radio power with isotropic power biases population comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Keep field conditional and component-labeled. Verify the luminosity formula, 4π, bandwidth, flux and distance convention before recalculation/use.
